items.detail: **Nvidia reports Tuesday after the close**. It is the first report since Jensen Huang resigned, and analysts expect about **$109 billion** in sales.
items.why: Its forecast will show whether the AI trade can steady after six losing weeks, with options pricing a move near 8%.

items.detail: **Wednesday's Fed minutes** and Chair Warsh's Monday remarks arrive with markets pricing about **90% odds** of a December rate hike.
items.why: Hawkish minutes would keep the 10-year yield above 5% and test the S&P 500's rally from 7,561.

items.detail: **Tuesday's October retail sales** and **Walmart's Thursday results** test the US shopper after September sales jumped 0.8%.
items.why: Strong spending supports a December hike, while a weak reading would ease rate fears but raise growth worries.

items.detail: With the dollar at a **19-month high**, China sets its **loan prime rate on Friday**, after holding it at 3.0% for 17 months.
items.why: A strong dollar pressures EM currencies, and Nvidia's results decide whether the Korea and Taiwan chip rally holds.

items.detail: **Monday's October WPI** follows September's **11.39%**. The NIFTY starts the week at 25,144 after three straight weekly gains on foreign buying.
items.why: A hot reading would revive talk of a December RBI hike, which could cool the foreign buying behind the gains.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** starts the week near **2,799**, and Wednesday's Fed minutes are its main test while December hike odds sit near 90%.
items.why: Small firms carry more floating-rate debt, so higher rates cut into their profits faster than big companies'.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** touched about **$62,000** on Sunday, a four-month low, and faces Tuesday's Nvidia results after US spot ETFs lost $1.07 billion last week.
items.why: A hawkish Fed or a tech selloff could extend ETF outflows, while a tech rebound would ease them.

items.detail: **Ether** is trading below $2,000, and US spot ETFs have lost about **$696 million** in November going into Wednesday's Fed minutes.
items.why: Higher rate-hike odds keep ETF buyers away, and record staking demand is the main support underneath.

items.detail: **Solana** is at a four-month low and below its 200-day average, with its ETFs losing money for **six straight weeks**.
items.why: It moves with bitcoin but swings harder, so Nvidia and the Fed minutes will likely set its direction.

items.detail: **Spot gold** opened the week near **$3,867**, and Wednesday's Fed minutes are its biggest test while the dollar sits at a 19-month high.
items.why: Hawkish minutes would lift yields and could push gold toward $3,800, while a divided Fed would help it.

crossCuttingTheme: Markets price about a 90% chance of a December Fed hike. Wednesday's minutes and Tuesday's Nvidia results will move Treasury yields and the dollar, and those will steer tech, emerging markets, crypto and gold.
